title: Soul Flame Denfense
description: A lightweight server-side mod that turns Soul Campfires into configurable defensive beacons, applying customizable status effects to nearby hostile mobs.
body:
# 🔥 Soul Flame Defense

Turn your **Soul Campfires** into powerful defensive beacons that automatically protect your base from nearby hostile mobs.

Instead of serving only as a decorative light source, Soul Campfires can now apply fully configurable status effects to enemies within range, giving them a meaningful role in survival gameplay while preserving the vanilla experience.

---

## ✨ Features

* 🔥 Automatically applies configurable status effects to nearby hostile mobs.
* 🎯 Configure exactly which mobs are affected.
* ⚙️ Fully customize effects, amplifier, duration, and detection radius.
* 🌍 Supports all Minecraft dimensions.
* 💾 Persistent campfire registry — existing Soul Campfires continue working after world or server restarts.
* ⚡ Lightweight and optimized for excellent performance.
* 👥 Fully compatible with both Singleplayer and Multiplayer.
* 🛠️ Built for Minecraft Forge **1.20.1**.

---

## ⚙️ Fully Configurable

Everything can be customized through configuration files:

* Hostile mob list
* Status effects
* Effect amplifier
* Effect duration
* Detection radius

Create the perfect defensive system for your survival world or modpack.

---
